_about: What the record says about immigrant visa interviews at US consulates, kept by hand. Every fact carries its primary source and the day it was read. The site (src/lib/consular/facts.ts), the planner and the health check (scripts/check_ingest_health.py, check_consular_facts) all read this file. Re-read the sources and move `checked` and `recheckBy` on or before the recheck day, or the health check warns.

pause.summary: The State Department postponed immigrant visa interviews worldwide in late August 2026 so consular officers could finish new public charge training, including an in-person part. It has published no list of the posts that have restarted and no end date.
pause.reinterviewsExempt: Cases refused under the 75-country pause and sent back for review are exempt from the in-person training, so some posts hold those second interviews while their first interviews stay paused.

sources.label: State's sworn declaration, Aug 28 2026
sources.quote: the Bureau of Consular Affairs is rescheduling immigrant visa appointments.

sources.label: State's sworn declaration, Sep 8 2026
sources.quote: four new training requirements that the Bureau of Consular Affairs formally deployed on September 1, 2026.

sources.label: State's sworn declaration, Oct 5 2026
sources.quote: the Department instructed all posts to complete a set of required trainings related to public charge visa ineligibility and inadmissibility, including an in-person training component, before processing and adjudicating immigrant visa applications

reported.label: Reuters, Sep 8 2026
reported.says: Processing resumed in Hungary and Poland.

seventyFive.label: The 75-country pause
seventyFive.summary: From January 21, 2026, consular officers refused immigrant visas to nationals of 75 countries under INA 221(g). Interviews went on; nothing was issued. A federal court struck the policy down on August 21, 2026.

sources.label: State's announcement, Jan 14 2026 (Internet Archive copy of Jul 14 2026)
CLINIC v. Rubio, opinion vacating the policy (S.D.N.Y. 1:26-cv-00858), Aug 21 2026

postAliases._about: Where State's scheduling table spells a post differently from its issuance tables: the table's name, folded, to the issuance key.
